title: Garmin’s new Fenix 9 adds brighter screens and smoother map panning
summary: The Fenix 9 and 9 Pro come equipped with an OLED display with up to 3,000 nits of brightness. The largest Fenix 9 Pro variation also offers a 1.5-inch OLED display for the first time.
